notes:
Inbound via self-serve signup -> quick start. Product: in-app assistant embedded in B2B SaaS UI (customer success + contextual help). Team: 6 engs (backend + infra), 2 ML/AI engineers. Wants streaming + token-level partial responses for perceived latency improvements. Quote from demo: "Users abandon if response > 200ms perceived. Streaming is a hard requirement."

Key asks: low median latency (<150ms ideal), drop-in hosted API with streaming websockets, predictable per-token cost for budgeting, and simple SAML/Google SSO for internal admin console. Prefers open/quantized models to control cost but wants Redwood to handle kernel/quantization recommendations.

Notes on traffic: expected pilot 500-1500 MAU, peak concurrency target 30-80 concurrent chat clients, burst tolerance required (end-of-month billing support chats). Budget band for pilot ~$800-$1.5k/month; ARR target if rollout succeeds $10k-$20k/year.

Security: SMB but cares about audit logs and SSO; will escalate SOC2 if enterprise sales route triggered. Data residency preference: US primary, EU for select customers later.

Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (Lena K.), CTO (Marco Ruiz), Dev lead (Samir B.).
timeline: 2025-11-02: self-serve signup on hosted API, trial credits applied
2025-11-05: first POC - basic echo + streaming test (internal note: median RTT ~180ms from us-east-1)
2025-11-12: SE (Priya) did a short architecture review via email; recommended streaming websocket and prefix caching
2025-11-18: discovery demo with AE (Ava) + SE (Priya); recorded (ff-20251118-CR4)

next_steps_detail: 1) Provision hosted API streaming POC (region: us-east-1) - SE to provide sample app integration. 2) Run 7-day pilot measuring median latency and tokens/month. 3) Deliver cost estimate + 1-page integration checklist. 4) Check SAML path with infra. Timeline: aim to decide by 2026-01.
sales_notes: Inbound SMB; high chance to convert to small monthly commit if latency SLOs met. Upsell path: Dedicated later for higher SLA and EU residency. AE to monitor usage; alert on token burn spike. Keep messaging on quantization & batching options to reduce costs.
technical_requirements:
- Streaming websocket support required.
- Target median latency <150ms (token streaming helps UX).
- Fallback behavior: prefer smaller quantized model if cost spike detected.
- Prefer AWS regions (us-east-1 primary, eu-west-1 secondary).
- Simple API keys for pilot; long-term require SAML for admin.
- Audit log export to customer's SIEM optional.
